gaps.current: A query with no match leaves a blank result panel: no 'no results' text, no hint to remove words, no links (screenshot base_zero.png for 'put my notebook online'; the count header h3 is simply absent). The panel lives in the theme's open shadow DOM (document.querySelectorAll('*') -> element.shadowRoot), so site CSS cannot style it.
